claim: Range Rover actual annual volume 2023-2025 from JLR results
words: JLR does not publish an L460-only volume in the releases found. FY24 (to 31 Mar 2024): 'wholesale volumes were 401,303 and retail sales were 431,733'; Q4 FY24 brand wholesales 'Range Rover (up 22% to 58,280 units)' - Range Rover BRAND = Range Rover + Sport + Velar + Evoque. FY25: wholesales 400,898; Defender 115,404; 'Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Defender ... 67.8%' of full-year wholesales. So 200,000/yr for the L460 is a user input, not a JLR figure: the whole Range Rover brand (four models) wholesaled 58,280 in Q4 FY24, about 233k annualised (own arithmetic).
